questions.question: Which of the following statements about the notochord is INCORRECT?

questions.question: Which of the following is a fundamental characteristic common to all chordates at some stage of their life cycle?

questions.question: Consider the following statements regarding the notochord: I. It is a mesodermally derived, solid, rod-like structure. II. It provides skeletal support. III.
